source_text: Ἀντεστρατήγει δὲ ἡ χάρις τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τοὺς μὲν ἀσθενεῖς ἐρρύετο, ἀντιπαρέτασσε δὲ στύλους ἑδραίους δυναμένους διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς πᾶσαν τὴν ὁρμὴν τοῦ πονηροῦ εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἑλκύσαι, οἳ καὶ ὁμόσε ἐχώρουν, πᾶν εἶδος ὀνειδισμοῦ καὶ κολάσεως ἀνεχόμενοι, οἳ καὶ τὰ πολλὰ ὀλίγα ἡγούμενοι ἔσπευδον πρὸς Χριστόν, ὄντως ἐπιδεικνύμενοι ὅτι οὐκ ἄξια τὰ παθήματα τοῦ νῦν καιροῦ πρὸς τὴν μέλλουσαν δόξαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι εἰς ἡμᾶς.
pass_a_gloss: But the grace of God was counter-maneuvering: it kept delivering the weak, while it kept stationing steady pillars, men capable by endurance of pulling onto themselves the whole assault of the evil one; these men closed with him hand to hand, putting up with every kind of insult and torment, and judging their many sufferings to be few, they were hastening toward Christ, truly showing that the sufferings of the present season are not of equal worth when set against the coming glory to be uncovered for us.
pass_b_english: Yet the grace of God was countering him move for move, sheltering the weak and drawing up in battle order firm pillars who could, by patient endurance, draw upon themselves the full violence of the Evil One. They went to close combat, bearing every kind of reproach and punishment, and counting great hardships as a small price, they pressed on toward Christ, proving in deed that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be set beside the glory that is to be revealed in us (Romans 8:18).

lemmas.gloss: to close quarters, hand to hand

choices.english: was countering him move for move
choices.why: imperfect middle with ἀντι- keeps the military metaphor of answering strategy with strategy, in an ongoing action
architectural-military image for steadfast men set in rank; keeps the concrete noun rather than abstracting to leaders

choices.english: counting great hardships as a small price
choices.why: participle of reckoning contrasts many sufferings with few in value, explaining their eagerness toward Christ
